name: WarpCal-Ising v0.1: thermal-warpage material-map calibration benchmark
description: Recover which build-up regions of a package substrate are copper-rich from a measured warpage field. Measurements come from an independent 3D finite-element digital twin; no public dataset pairing warpage maps with ground-truth material layouts was found.

geometry_mm.note: Two-layer asymmetric stack: core at the bottom, build-up (ABF dielectric + copper) on top. Substrate scale follows published flip-chip examples (about 1 mm thick).

core.source: Substrate row of Table 1, Tsai, Wang & Liu, Materials 14:3723 (2021) (also reproduced in the Cadence warpage white paper, Table 3)

buildup_nominal.source: ABF GX-T31 values as reported in secondary summaries (CTE 23 ppm/K for 25-150 C, 7.5 GPa); Poisson ratio assumed. To confirm against the Ajinomoto datasheet.

buildup_cu_rich.rule: Voigt mixture of buildup_nominal and copper at copper_fraction; CTE stiffness-weighted (Turner)

thermal.source: Zero curvature at 120 C observed by shadow moire for a flip-chip package with this substrate (Tsai, Wang & Liu 2021); measured at 25 C, below Tg, so linear elasticity applies
thermal.reflow_profile_note: Published shadow-moire studies sweep 25 -> 260 -> 25 C; only the below-Tg room-temperature point is used here.

fea.mesh: 12 x 12 in-plane, 2 elements through each layer
fea.boundary: free body, 3-2-1 constraints on bottom corners
fea.output: top-surface out-of-plane displacement on a 25 x 25 grid, best-fit plane removed (moire convention)
fea.verification: uniform-layer curvature compared with classical lamination theory
fea.external_validation: Same solver reproduces the Tsai et al. 2021 flip-chip package (31x31 mm substrate, 10x10 mm die): corner warpage -59.2 um vs -58 um shadow moire at 25 C; 3.2 um RMS vs moire over 25-260 C (85 um range). See validate_flipchip.py, validation_tsai2021_flipchip.txt

calibration_model.physics: Kirchhoff thin plate on the 25 x 25 grid; region parameters from classical lamination theory of the same nominal stack (never fitted to the FEA)
calibration_model.posterior: Gaussian likelihood, uniform prior over maps; noise level by maximum marginal likelihood
calibration_model.ising_form: J = A^T A / (4 sigma^2), h from A and the data

metrics: regions correct in the most-probable map
posterior probability and rank of the true map
number of maps holding 90% of probability (uncertainty)
full-field warpage prediction error, RMS um: nominal design model vs calibrated posterior mean
simulated annealing baseline (2,000 single flips): probability of finding the most-probable map
exact Metropolis spectral gap: single-flip, uniform, quantum (Layden ensemble) ideal and at measured hardware fidelity
measurement_noise_reference: iNEMI IEMT 2016: shadow moire resolution 0.85-1.27 um, within 1-3 um on a flatness standard; Tsai 2021 moire sensitivity 12.7 um/fringe
